response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) as fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" means explicitly filtering out records where rebrate is NULL. "Such fee records" refers to fee records matching both criteria: feerate > 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: "Such fee records" refers to all records with feerate > 0.0009, regardless of rebrate nullability. The count includes all matching records; AVG() naturally excludes NULL ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) as fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009;
